nom: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Pad

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin says the product does not make it greasy, while another states the pads are not ideal for oily skin because they stick together.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the pads are hydrating and soft, help prevent breakouts linked to dryness, and do not irritate the skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report good hydration without greasiness or dryness, and one notes improvement in acne and texture after two uses.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or combination-sensitive skin mostly report no irritation, redness, or dryness, though one very sensitive reviewer got small red bumps from the botanical extracts.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the pads as effective for dehydrated skin, used as a quick sheet mask on dry areas, with the essence deeply absorbed; one dry-skin reviewer with dehydration-triggered breakouts reports the issue stopped.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports redness around the nose and forehead improved within a week of use, including a targeted trick of splitting a pad on the cheeks; another with sensitive-combination skin reports no redness caused by the product.
concerns.spots: One reviewer says acne appears smaller with use and another reports calming of acne, while a sensitive-skin reviewer instead developed small red bumps from the formula.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers, including those with dry, combination, and sensitive skin, state the product did not cause breakouts; one sensitive reviewer is the exception, reporting a few small red bumps.
concerns.oiliness: One combination-skin reviewer reports the product does not make oily areas greasy; another reviewer feels the pads leave a slightly tacky residue rather than a clean finish.

aspects.libelle: Slightly tacky, not fully clean feel
Good value for amount of product
Small red bumps from botanical extract

extraits.texte: These toner pads are made with is a really lovely hydrating toner. The pads themselves are neither great not bad (mostly just forgettable), but the essence is great. It feels lightweight but immediately nourishing on the skin, preps the face well for subsequent makeup steps, and has absolutely no scent or fragrance. I fell in love with this right away, but sadly I did get a few very small red bumps from using this. I have remarkably sensitive skin so I don't expect this to be a typical experience, but if you find that botanical extracts don't agree with your skin, then this might not be for you. Other than that though, I would recommend these to all ages and skin types. It is very easy to make a quick sheet mask for dehydrated people by just placing a toner pad on areas of the face that need extra hydration and leaving them for a couple minutes before proceeding with the rest of your skincare (when I do this I use 3; one on the forehead and one on each cheek).
Its not bad but i dont think it would work well for oily skin type. The pads stick tocether and you have to pull it apart.

extraits.titre: Exactly what I was looking for!
extraits.texte: I absolutely love this product! I figured it was time I start incorporating new and better items into my skin care routine but I also wanted to be budget conscious. These birch wood toner pads popped up when I googled 'top toner pads of 2023' and I am so glad they did! They are so hydrating I can't believe I've waited so long to try them! I leave them on for a max of 5 minutes, and when I peel them off I squeeze the excess liquid out and pat it into my skin. I am so happy I use these and plan to make it a staple in my skincare routine for 2024. I have combination skin but this doesn't break me out, it doesn't make my oily skin greasy and it doesn't dehydrate my dry skin like micellar water does. Would absolutely recommend and I already have to many others who have purchased. 5 star product without a doubt!

I love these toner pads.I used them in my 7 step daily skin care routine. Ive been using them for 1 week and they helped my skin redness around nose and on forehead. I also used a little hack: I ripped 1 pad into 2 pieces and placed them on my cheeks for 2 mins in the am and redness went away. The solution didnt cause any break outs. It kept my skin well moisturized and dewy all day. I used it twice a day. I like that the pads come well soaked in the product and dont have alcohol as component. 10/10 recommend.

These pads are so soft and soaked with essence. It's unbelievable. My skin like drank this essence. I have very dry skin that tends to break out when it gets too dry. I now have a super smooth solution for this problem. No break out. No make-up greasing. Love it.

I don't understand why no one is talking abt this product but I have combination and sensitive skin and this one helped me in just 2 uses to heal some of my acne and textured skin. Would definitely recommend, would definitely repurchase ^^

extraits.titre: Works well on combination sensitive skin
extraits.texte: This Birch Juice moisturizing pads hydrates without feeling sticky on the skin. It leaves the skin feeling hydrated and soft. I have combination sensitive skin and this did not cause any redness, irritation or sensitivity.
